verdict.rationale: SolidJS's core design explicitly supports component-based composition with automatic dependency-tracked local reactive state (createSignal-style, per gh-1/9/11), a render-once function model (gh-10), and built-in Context/Stores for cross-component state (gh-2), all corroborated by hands-on developer accounts praising the componentization experience (solid-comm-2, solid-comm-9). Missing for 10: no explicit code example of nested component composition or props passing in the evidence, and some community friction around prop reactivity/destructuring pitfalls (solid-comm-5, solid-comm-11) suggests real-world caveats in composing components smoothly.
